sentences.text:
Counsel for Petitioner :- Ram Bilas Yadav,Ashutosh Kumar Tiwari Counsel for Respondent :- A.S.G.I.,C.S.C.,Sanjay Kumar Om,Ved Mani Tiwari Hon'ble Mrs. Sunita Agarwal,J.
Hon'ble Vipin Chandra Dixit,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner.
Sri Ved Mani Tiwari, learned counsel appearing on behalf of respondent is present.
This is wholly misconceived petition seeking compensation for the acquired land belonging to the petitioners for construction of National Highway at the market value along with admissible interest.

Self-contradictory averments have been made in the writ petition with regard to the acquisition of the land in question and there is no categorical assertion with respect to the acquisition notifications under Section 3D of the National Highways Act, 1956 for making of an award by the competent authority.

National Highways Authority is also not impleaded and the description of respondent no. 1 in the array of parties is cryptic.
